audio.method: Real WebAudio analyser RMS, with effects and ambience zero for the score test, then music/ambience zero for the button test. This verifies generated signal, not a human listening review.

limitations: Native clips are preferred; runtime authored motion is not represented as native game animation.
Unrigged models receive root motion, not invented skeletal clips.
243 exact variants still lack an accepted 3D source and remain explicitly labeled 2D fallbacks.
Metadata validation covers all accepted model records; representative browser visuals only.
Audio output was measured with a real WebAudio analyser; no human listening review is claimed.
